hero.description: A registered youth welfare association from S. Sankaralingapuram, Madurai District, working quietly and steadily for education, health, relief and community upliftment since our founding.

about.title: Rooted in Community, Driven by Service
about.intro: Annaparavai Youth Welfare Association was established with the primary objective of promoting social welfare and empowering the youth. The association was formed to strengthen unity among the villagers, encourage social responsibility among young people, and carry forward meaningful community service initiatives.

history.title: Our History
history.body: Since its inception, the association has been continuously carrying out various community service activities such as tree plantation drives, educational awareness programmes, blood donation camps, medical camps, sports and cultural events, social service initiatives, and public welfare projects. Guided by the noble vision of 'United Youth – Prosperous Society,' our association remains committed to earning the trust of the people and implementing many more welfare programmes in the future.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To promote social unity and brotherhood, develop the leadership and talents of youth, create awareness on education, employment and entrepreneurship, provide assistance to the poor and underprivileged, encourage tree plantation and environmental conservation, organize blood donation camps, medical camps and welfare programmes, promote sports, arts and cultural activities, undertake welfare initiatives for women, children and senior citizens, conduct anti-drug and social awareness campaigns, provide voluntary service during natural disasters, guide people in accessing government welfare schemes, and work with the motto: 'Let Us Serve – Let Us Grow Together – Let Us Build Progress.'

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To become a leading youth welfare association dedicated to social responsibility, build a society founded on unity, humanity and the spirit of service, empower youth through education, skill development and employment opportunities, serve as a model in environmental protection and sustainable development, ensure equal opportunities and welfare reach every section of society, implement sustainable rural development initiatives, grow into a respected welfare association at the district and state levels, nurture volunteers who lead positive social change, create a safe, healthy and prosperous society for future generations, and uphold the vision: 'Service is Our Identity – Progress is Our Goal.'

objectives.title: Our Objectives
items: Promote unity and volunteerism among the youth
Support education through scholarships, tuition support and awareness drives
Organise health camps, blood donation drives and hygiene awareness programmes
Provide relief and support during floods, disasters and personal emergencies
Preserve and celebrate Tamil culture, festivals and local traditions
Maintain full transparency in registration, finances and governance
